facts.fact: The ITU repository lists the National Digital Transformation Strategy as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of the National Digital Transformation Strategy as 2025 - 2030.
The repository names the High Commission for Digitization as lead/owner of the National Digital Transformation Strategy.
